Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread Budd Boetticher’s birth year from the Wikipedia page as 1906 when the page clearly showed 1916. This led to an incorrect interim conclusion that Boetticher was born earlier than Don “Red” Barry (1910), reversing the comparison and pointing toward the wrong film.
